line.name: Henry Clay War Hawk Rebellious
line.description: CLARIFICATION: confirmed to be a distinct limited-edition blend, NOT simply a size/vitola within the regular War Hawk line - different wrapper, different origin, different factory, different blender. A Nicaraguan puro, single-vitola limited edition. Released July 2020; limited run of 1,200 boxes of 20 (24,000 cigars total). Launch price $9.60/cigar, $192/box of 20.
line.factory: Tabacalera A.J. Fernandez Cigars de Nicaragua S.A., Esteli, Nicaragua (rolled under Abdel Fernandez)
line.status: limited edition (2020 run, now likely sold through)
